title: DojoLiq Black Grape 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid by Vaporesso
description: Experience the bold taste of Vaporesso DojoLiq Black Grape, a robust berry blend that highlights the distinct character of dark orchard fruit. Every draw provides the deep, juicy sweetness of ripe Black Grape, offering a rich and highly authentic flavour profile. The taste remains consistently vivid from the initial inhale right through to the smooth, satisfying finish. To ensure peak performance, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid features a finely tuned 45% VG / 55% PG ratio specifically optimised for this blend. This bespoke formulation guarantees rapid wicking and maximum flavour transmission when used with Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) pod systems and starter vape kits. The Nicotine Salt blend ensures a gentle throat feel and fast-acting nicotine relief. Available in 5mg,10mg and 20mg strengths Created by industry leaders Vaporesso, the DojoLiq range translates the richly formulated, vivid flavours of their famous Dojo devices into a premium bottled e-liquid. Choose from 10mg or 20mg strengths to find the perfect level of satisfaction for your everyday vaping needs.
